Acoustic plaster is recommended in the article, not banned; it improves concrete block performance. While moisture can affect masonry, this is a construction quality issue, not an acoustic design concern specific to this assembly. 8-inch concrete block with acoustic plaster and cavity absorption achieves STC 46–52, a range that overlaps STC 50 but does not guarantee it. The lower bound (STC 46) falls below the code requirement, making this a borderline design. A more robust solution (e.g., staggered studs, resilient channel) would reliably achieve STC 50 with minimal risk. Designers should specify assemblies with performance ranges clearly above the minimum to account for field variability.
